visual_review: Full-resolution frames from all eight scenes and encoded samples at 01:30, 05:04 and 05:51 were inspected for legibility and timing.
audio_review: Local speech recognition recovered the narration sequence and key terms; it transcribed some Sanskrit names phonetically. Manual listening was not performed.
editorial_review: Dates and broad social descriptions are attributed to the supplied textbook. The map is marked schematic, and social experiences are not represented as universal.
